args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! We're so pleased to hear you're joining our team next week in the marketing department.

I'm Emma Johnson, and I'll be part of your team as well. I'm sure you'll be a wonderful addition — your background in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management is exactly the kind of expertise our team benefits from.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything I can help you with before your first day, whether it's getting set up, meeting the team, or just getting oriented. We're all looking forward to having you on board.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
